query:
SELECT s.companyName, m.id, m.timeSlot, m.attendeeNumber, m.status, m.isVisible, m.matchScore, m.matchReason
FROM meetings m
JOIN sponsors s ON s.id = m.sponsorId
WHERE m.attendeeId = '200101377371'
ORDER BY s.companyName, m.timeSlot;
